summary: This 1982 memo argues against the claim that international protocol standards already offer a basis for cheap, vendor-supported implementations. It is an opinion piece, originally a MITRE Corporation report, not a protocol specification.

eli5.summary: Someone says that buying ready-made network software is not as cheap or easy as sellers claim, because the grand promises are bigger than what you actually get.

questions: are vendors supporting international protocol standards
opinion on osi standards versus arpanet protocols
